skill.description: Quickly search and navigate the codebase - Use when you need to quickly find files, search for patterns, or locate specific code without deep analysis.

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive. The cited line tells the explorer to avoid deep design changes and focus on navigation, which is consistent with a read-only code discovery skill.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid deep design changes; prioritize navigation and context.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 26 instructs the agent to avoid deep design changes and prioritize navigation context. This is workflow guidance, not system reconnaissance or host information gathering.

content.value_statement: Large repositories slow down orientation and targeted searches. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code locate files, symbols, and context quickly.
actual_capabilities: Locates relevant files, symbols, and definitions in a repository.
Searches for patterns and related code references.
Summarizes findings with precise file references.
Suggests next files or symbols to inspect.
Supports read-only exploration with write and edit tools disabled.
limitations: Does not make file edits or design changes.
Does not perform deep architecture analysis by default.
Depends on the repository files and search results available to the agent.
Does not replace security, performance, or correctness review.

use_cases.title: Find Entry Points
use_cases.description: Locate the main files, handlers, or commands that control a feature before making changes.

use_cases.title: Map Unknown Code
use_cases.description: Get a concise list of relevant files and symbols when onboarding to an unfamiliar repository.

use_cases.title: Prepare Focused Reviews
use_cases.description: Identify the files and references that deserve inspection before a design, bug, or migration review.

prompt_templates.title: Find a File
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the explorer skill to find files related to authentication and summarize the most relevant paths.

prompt_templates.title: Locate a Symbol
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the explorer skill to find where the payment retry logic is defined and where it is called.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a Feature Area
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the explorer skill to map the files involved in user settings, including entry points and related tests.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Investigation Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the explorer skill to identify the smallest set of files needed to review the caching behavior and suggest the next symbols to inspect.

output_examples.input: Find files related to session management.
output: Lists likely session files with short notes about each role.
Highlights definitions, call sites, and related tests.
Suggests the next symbols to inspect.

output_examples.input: Map the code involved in user profile updates.
output: Groups relevant files by entry point, service logic, and persistence layer.
Includes precise references so the user can open the right locations.
Keeps the summary focused on navigation, not implementation changes.

best_practices: Start with a clear feature, symbol, or behavior to search for.
Ask for concise file references before requesting deeper analysis.
Use the suggested next files to narrow follow-up searches.
anti_patterns: Do not ask this skill to implement changes directly.
Do not treat discovery summaries as a complete architecture review.
Do not use vague prompts when a feature name or symbol is known.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps an AI agent quickly find files, symbols, definitions, and related code in a repository.

faq.question: Can it edit my code?
faq.answer: No. The skill metadata disables write and edit tools, so it is intended for read-only exploration.

faq.question: Which tools support it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it useful for large repositories?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed for fast discovery when a repository is too large to inspect manually.

faq.question: Does it perform deep design analysis?
faq.answer: No. Its instructions prioritize navigation and context over deep design changes.

faq.question: What should I provide in a prompt?
faq.answer: Provide a feature name, symbol, behavior, or file pattern that the agent should locate.
